card.name: Words before media or communications roles
card.fires_on: Linking or title words inside job titles and organization names, in science-institution contact or credit lines, where a word like media, communications or public affairs is likely to come next.

modes.label: Job title links
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'for' inside a title such as director or office of, before a communications-type term.
modes.example: German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases +49 228 / 43302-260 Director<< of>> Communications Hertie-Institut

modes.label: Inside institution names
modes.description: Part of a science agency or institute name or channel, such as NASA Sci or EMBL, near video or media credits.
modes.example: |Search Results (6 videos found)| |NASAS<<ci>>Files - Meteors NASA Sci

modes.label: Outreach verbs
modes.description: The word 'to' after verbs like working or helps, describing promoting or publicizing work.
modes.example: In this role she helps<< to>> promote the work of the Innovation Explor

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying media, news or broadcasting words next.
card.plain: It fires in staff titles and institute names where a media or communications term is expected next.
